reviewer: Project review after the browser verdict, written with Claude Code (the AI assistant that built this project). A reading of the patch, not another test.
verdict: Works, but not acceptable upstream as written
summary: The field keeps an ISO date because the default display format becomes YYYY-MM-DD. That fixes the submitted value, but every datepicker without its own dateFormat would now show ISO dates instead of locale-formatted ones.
caveats: The pending human fix keeps the localized display and changes only what is submitted; that is the better trade-off.
Useful for an app that wants ISO in the field; not proposed upstream.
